title: TAP SBOM completeness rules
description: Per-ecosystem requirements for the SBOM field-completeness check (req-cicd-sbom-32). Validated at load; an unknown key, an unknown requirement name, a missing description or an invalid file fails the load and the check reports not-observable (req-cicd-sbom-32-2).

_description.description: Human/AI-readable purpose of this rules file and where its starting rows came from.

format.description: Format discriminator; bump on breaking shape changes.

ecosystems.description: One entry per purl ecosystem the check has a rule for, keyed by the purl type (the text between pkg: and the first slash). A component whose ecosystem is absent here is a gap of class unruled-ecosystem.

_description.description: Why this ecosystem requires these fields.

require_attributes.description: Inventory attributes the grid reads (req-cicd-sbom-33-7). Each is satisfied by the attribute or by an explicit not-observed marker with a reason. A gap is reported at intake and makes the verdict thin when attributes are enforced, as at image generation.

items.description: licenses-or-declared-unknown: the component has licenses, or tap:licenses:status is not-observed with tap:licenses:reason. architecture-or-declared-unknown: the same with tap:architecture.

declared_unknown_limit.description: How many components of this ecosystem may declare a required attribute unknown before the verdict is thin (default 0).

require.description: The fields a component of this ecosystem must carry.

items.description: A closed vocabulary: each name maps to one check in completeness.py. purl-qualifier:upstream-when-origin-differs requires the upstream qualifier only when syft:metadata:originPackage differs from the component name.

operating_system.description: The rule for the single operating-system component (req-cicd-sbom-32-5).

_description.description: Why the operating-system component is required.

require.description: Fields the operating-system component must carry.
